svg.title: Top-3 recall per condition at 100%, 50% and 25% evidence
svg.desc: The share of each condition's patients whose true condition is ranked in the top 3, with its 95% bootstrap interval (1,000 resamples, seed 42). Each component alone; B1-DL′+aug is the configured ranker. * must-not-miss. Validation split, 33,963 patients. DDXPlus is synthetic, so these figures describe its generator, not real patients. Closed world: only 13 conditions can be named (R-13). Evidence masked by docs/05 §3.7 (digests e99a7a8fbf792675 / af3a357f6454838a): the same patients at every level, each 25% history inside its 50% one; the masks remove answers at random, which a clinician's questions do not. The component alone, not fused. EXP-023. B2 is the knowledge graph alone, built from the DDXPlus definitions that generated these patients, so its figures are circular (R-12).
